question: Should `claimState` be an authoritative boolean derived from active publisher memberships, and may a bounded lookup ever return `claimed` without observing an active user?
rationale: This value represents publisher identity or control and may feed future trust surfaces; code review establishes the false-positive, but maintainers must choose whether the durable contract is exact, explicitly unknown, or deferred.

options.title: Require exact claim evidence
options.body: Return `claimed` only after observing an active linked or membership user, and use `unclaimed` or a defined unknown state when a bounded search is inconclusive.

options.title: Defer claim state
options.body: Land only official and restriction facts while postponing claim semantics until a complete ownership-verification contract is approved.

options.title: Accept conservative claimed
options.body: Keep the cap fallback and document that claimed may reflect unverified membership-row presence rather than an observed active account.

recommendation.title: Require exact claim evidence
recommendation.body: Return `claimed` only after observing an active linked or membership user, and use `unclaimed` or a defined unknown state when a bounded search is inconclusive.
